item.title: Thousands of pheasants to be released toward end of hunting season, here's where
item.description: PENNSYLVANIA (WTAJ) -- For the second consecutive year, the Pennsylvania Game Commission announced that it will be releasing over 8,000 pheasants for hunting recreation.
